items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 20 at 9:49AM EDT until September 20 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT....Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...The beaches of Currituck County.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.
